todos: [P1] ENV-PYTHON312-VENV-01: .venv is broken: pyvenv.cfg points to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Python\Python312 (3.12.10), which is no longer installed; py -0p lists only 3.13. On 2026-09-26 .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q failed with 'No Python at ...\Python312\python.exe'. This blocks the Sidecar tests (133), test:e2e:ingest-translate (dev Sidecar from .venv) and the PyInstaller build of sidecar.exe used by package:win and test:e2e:sidecar-ownership. .python-version and scripts/setup_dev_environment.ps1 require 3.12.x. Fix: install Python 3.12.10 (user action), run powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/setup_dev_environment.ps1 to recreate the venv, then run the Sidecar tests.

[P2] QWEN38-FULLTASK-01: Live full-task results of 2026-09-26 after the audit. qwen3-coder:30b run audit-20260926c: VERIFIED, 8/8 milestones, 37/50 steps, about 53 min, median prompt eval 5.0 s and median step 21 s (qwen3.8 on 2026-09-25: 57.9 s and 128 s); installs approved, build fixed after 3 failures (snapshot %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live\snapshots\*audit-20260926c*). Run audit-20260926b (before the stall fix) closed on transport_budget: Ollama sends nothing while a tool call is generated and a 1193-token write at 3.95 tok/s hit the fixed 5-minute stall limit twice (now speed-based). qwen3.8:27b: run audit-20260926 was stopped by the assistant at step 5 to fix the transcript; step 1-2 telemetry showed num_ctx 65536, 83% CPU / 17% GPU, a full 37 s prompt re-evaluation at step 2 and 1092 thinking tokens at about 2.85 tok/s (6.4 min per turn with the model's default 'medium' thinking). A direct probe (%USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live\audit\cacheprobe-20260926.mjs) showed qwen3.8 does reuse its cache both when appending and when replacing the trailing message (4.4 s / 6.8 s vs 40.9 s cold), so the step-2 miss is still unexplained: suspect the rendering of the assistant thinking in history (think omitted = model default). Run audit-20260926b with the append-only transcript was stopped at the user's request before any telemetry. Next: rerun qwen3.8 with a unique ONLYRAG_LIVE_RUN, check per-turn promptEvalDurationMs from step 2 on; if misses persist, compare with modelThinkingPreferences['qwen3.8:27b']='low' or false and with thinking stripped from history. Workspaces fulltask_qwen3-coder-30b-audit-20260926, -audit-20260926b, -audit-20260926c and fulltask_qwen3-8-27b-audit-20260926, -audit-20260926b are disposable after their snapshots (cleanup tracked in LIVE-QWEN-WORKSPACE-CLEANUP-01).

[P2] RELEASE-REVERIFY-01: The coding-agent audit landed in commit 890d0dd (2026-09-26 09:19). After it, on 2026-09-26, typecheck, quality:static, audit:deadcode, audit:cycles, docs:check, test:fast (277 files, 2244 tests) and test:e2e:electron (8 reliability + 9 guard scenarios) passed. Not rerun since the audit: Sidecar tests, test:e2e:sidecar-ownership, test:e2e:cold-start, test:e2e:settings-bootstrap, test:e2e:bundle-ux, test:e2e:ingest-translate, npm run package:win (release/ still holds the installer built on 2026-09-25 00:25, before the audit) and the full audit script. Needs ENV-PYTHON312-VENV-01 first; then rerun them and update the AGENTS.md verification paragraph.

[P2] AGENT-AUDIT-20260926-RESIDUALS-01: The coding-agent audit of 2026-09-26 (docs/coding-agent-audit-2026-09-26.md) left these open. (1) PersistentPowerShellSession never tracks the shell's real cwd, so structuredCommandSafety resolves relative paths against the workspace root: 'cd ..' from a subfolder is refused (conservative) and paths after a cd are judged from the root. (2) normalizePowerShellCommand rewrites 'npx X' to 'npx -y X', and shellCommandHasEgress does not treat a bare npx of a package missing from node_modules/.bin as network use: npx can install an unrelated package without consent. (3) No background-process tool or port probe for dev servers; blocked servers still end as a refused command. (4) replace_file_content and multi_replace_file_content return no compact diff and no typecheck feedback, unlike write_file, and the TypeScript check runs synchronously on the Electron main thread. (5) git_commit uses a 15 s timeout (pre-commit hooks), git_diff omits untracked files the agent created, approval cards label web_search/fetch as write_file, and validate_visual_artifact reports a page load failure as 'Playwright runtime unavailable'.

[P2] AGENT-LEGACY-TEXT-PATH-01: Native /api/chat is the only agent path since the audit of 2026-09-26, but every turn still builds the legacy single-string turnPrompt (agentPromptAssembler + HeuristicContextCompactor), computes decideContextReuse (ollamaContextCacheManager) and keeps the /api/generate branch of AgentStreamTransport.streamCompletion, the text tool catalogue and parseAgentToolCall. They only feed the debug log now. Remove them with their tests after confirming no caller outside the native path, and log the real chat messages instead.

[P2] AGENT-DIRECTIVE-AUTHORITY-02: The audit of 2026-09-26 made planDirectiveArbiter policy-aware, filtered policy-refused tools from the catalogue and turned the version-behind and milestone-redelivery orders into notes, but other tool-result producers still end with 'Directives: MUST' blocks (compilerDiagnosticDirective, testFailureDiagnostic, moduleResolutionDiagnostic, npmVersionNotFound, npmResolutionConflict, installVersionDowngrade, redundantWriteDetector, loopDetector interventions). Convert them to facts the arbiter consumes, add an invariant test that no two orders can reach one turn, and review the guards that never fired in 67 live snapshots for removal.

[P2] CODING-HISTORY-RESET-01: The original backup at %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Backups\coding-agent-20260925-170040 has 58 valid SHA-256 copies; five source files in .onlyrag_v2\sessions are already absent. The qwen3.8 run added two history files, copied and hash-verified in coding-agent-20260925-qwen38-extra. Thus 55 session/state/tracker files remain, including 32 in the retired workspaces. The user explicitly authorized reset on 2026-09-25, but automatic execution review rejected the exact targeted Remove-Item -LiteralPath -Force operation as blocked by policy. No history file was removed. When policy permits, recheck hashes and paths, remove only verified history files, preserve code, documents, snapshots, backups and live workspaces, then verify the app starts with empty history.

[P3] AGENT-SAMPLING-UI-01: settings.modelSamplingOverrides (temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, repeat_penalty, presence_penalty, num_thread per model) is validated and applied by the agent since 2026-09-26 but has no Settings UI; users can only set it in settings.json.

[P3] AGENT-FOLLOWUP-STATE-01: A follow-up run in the same conversation restores the previous chatMessages after the new task and the pinned runtime profile (model and num_ctx) overrides current settings (agentOrchestratorSessionContext.ts). Decide whether a follow-up keeps the transcript, and let a changed model or context setting take effect.

[P3] CAPABILITY-POLICY-UNSET-01: sanitizeAppSettings always yields a capabilityPolicyMode (default network-approved since 2026-09-26), yet AppSettings.capabilityPolicyMode is still optional (shared/types/index.ts: 'Undefined preserves the legacy unrestricted mode') and two paths still treat an unset mode as unrestricted: AgentToolExecutorService.policyBlock returns null (no policy check at all) and installsAllowed in agentOrchestratorCircuitBreakerAndVerification.ts allows installs ('or the legacy unset one'). The branches are dead for sanitized settings but fail open for any caller that builds AppSettings by hand. Make the field required, drop the unset branches and update the tests that omit it.

[P3] LEGACY-MIGRATIONS-01: One-time migrations from earlier layouts are still executed on every launch or read, while this is a single-user install and CODING-HISTORY-RESET-01 will empty the history anyway. Renderer: AppLayout.tsx imports localStorage onlyrag_app_settings, onlyrag_initial_setup_completed and onlyrag_language when settings.json is missing; useSessionHistory and useWorkspaceProjects push localStorage data through sessions:migrate-legacy and projects:migrate-legacy (ipcContract, secureIpcMain schemas, sessionHistoryIpc, projectRegistryIpc, SessionHistoryAppService, ProjectRegistryAppService, projectRegistryDomain merge). Main: appSettingsRepository.decodeSettingsFile accepts unversioned settings and rewrites maxToolCallSteps>=200; agentSessionStateRepository moves .onlyrag/.agent_state_*.json and .assistant/SESSION_TRACKER.md; sessionHistoryRepository moves .onlyrag/session_history.json; sidecarProcessManager migrates legacy nested data entries; restoreFileVersionEvidence accepts the pre per-file { filePath, contentHash }; plan code still recognises legacy synthetic finish milestones (agentOrchestratorApplicationClosure.ts, planAndSolveGraph.ts, agentTaskContract.ts defaults). The scripts/e2e/settingsBootstrap.mjs cases cover the localStorage path. After the history reset, confirm the local stores are on the current layout, then remove each migration with its IPC channel, tests and E2E cases, keeping the settings.json version check.

[P3] I18N-MAIN-MESSAGES-01: agent:log supports structured localized keys from shared/domain/agent/agentMainText.ts, with Italian fallback text. Closure, diagnostics, plan, loop, circuit-breaker, prompt assembly and response interpretation messages were migrated previously. On 2026-09-25 ToolExecutionResult gained a validated localized.message field, forwarded by agentOrchestratorToolResultProcessor without parsing logMessage; the main run_command and run_tests results now use it. Remaining: other tool result producers (filesystem, web, Git, recovery, diagnostics and process preconditions), fixed-language Main emitLog and error strings in the files named in earlier revisions, sessionDebtTracker markdown, and Sidecar chunk prefix [Documento: ... | Sezione: ...] (requires re-index migration). Preserve parsed prefixes Task Finished:, Consulting LLM (<model>), the AI Agent Question marker and Loop banners. Verification on 2026-09-25: npm run typecheck, npm run build, npm run quality:static, npm run docs:check and 99 targeted Vitest tests passed; the full fast suite passed on 2026-09-26 (277 files, 2244 tests). Next session: migrate other tool result producers through localized.message, then the remaining Main strings; do not infer keys from English logMessage.

[P3] TEST-HYGIENE-STDERR-01: npm run test:fast passes but prints avoidable stderr: src/hooks/useDiagnostics.test.ts (5x 'The current testing environment is not configured to support act(...)': IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT is set per file, as in AgentEvidenceCard.test.tsx, instead of once in the dom project setup), src/hooks/useWorkspaceFiles.test.tsx (electronAPI mock lacks listWorkspaceFiles), src/components/translation/TranslationView.test.tsx (2 cases: the electronApi mock lacks getIngestedDocument, logged by DocumentMarkdown). Set the act flag in the dom setup file, complete the mocks, and consider failing the dom project on unexpected console.error.
